title: Oracle: missing privileges fail at login or at the first query, before the grant list

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: Oracle Free 23.26.3, four users with different grants

symptom: No CREATE SESSION: ORA-01045 at login. CREATE SESSION only: ORA-00942 on SYS.V_$DATABASE ("Could not fetch database name"). A table without SELECT: GENERIC_SNAPSHOT_FAILURE with ORA-00942. None of the three reaches the missing-privilege list.
cause: The checks run in connection order.
effect: The first error hides the rest of the required grants.
fix: Grant CREATE SESSION, then the full grant list, then SELECT on each table; check with VALIDATE_SETUP.
